## Summary

What changes for the user, and why?

## Checks

- [ ] `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest`
- [ ] `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug`
- [ ] Checked on a phone or emulator when the change is visual
- [ ] No key, token, personal path, chat transcript, or real user data
- [ ] A skill change follows the contract in `SKILLS.md`

## Notes

Screenshots, known limitations, or a follow-up that is deliberately out of scope.
